About.Title: About
About.Description: Viora is a modular Windows studio for image creation, transformation and stylization. Its first capability is the Anime Vector conversion preset — and its plugin system is built so the next capability can come from anyone.
About.Author: Built by the Viora project.
About.License: Released under the GNU AGPL-3.0 license.

Help.GettingStarted.Title: Getting started
Help.GettingStarted.Body: Open Convert, drop in an image, pick the Anime Vector preset, adjust the palette and smoothing, then export. Everything runs locally.

Sponsor.Title: Sponsor
Sponsor.Subtitle: Support Viora's development.
Sponsor.Body: Viora is free and open source. Sponsorships pay for build servers, reference assets and the occasional coffee that keeps commits coming. Sponsorship is entirely optional — the app has no paid gates.
Sponsor.Thanks: Thank you to everyone who has supported the project!
Legal.Title: Legal
Legal.Subtitle: Agreements, privacy and licenses.
Legal.UserAgreement.Body: Viora is provided under the GNU AGPL-3.0. By using the application you agree to the license terms governing its distribution and reuse. The software is provided "as is", without warranty of any kind; you are responsible for the images you process and export with it.
Legal.PrivacyPolicy.Body: Viora runs entirely on your machine. It does not upload your images, does not create accounts and does not embed analytics. Crash and diagnostic logs stay in the local application-data folder and are written only on this device; file paths in logs can be redacted in Settings → Privacy. If you later choose to share logs or feedback, you choose what leaves the device.
Legal.OssLicenses.Body: Viora depends on the following open-source projects, each under its own MIT/Apache license. Full license texts ship with the source distribution.
